steps.description: LAC-2087: clean smoke reproduces daemon acquire then operator hold without a next acquire, while the watcher PID remains live. It also verifies that a concrete coexistence operation retains its waiter across a soft caller deadline and removes it on terminal/stacked-base exits before closure dispatch or errors, while eventual eligible contention retains it. Late errors are logged without a test-owned rejection handler. Missing candidate bases use the stored review base for cleanup. It verifies obsolete daemon waiter removal, preservation and arrival order of another live daemon, ordinary FIFO order and following closer acquisition without expiry or bypass. Ineligibility, head movement and merge completion remove them immediately; confirmed dead same-host watchers are pruned and uncertain identities expire. Carried clean verdicts still reach ordinary merge eligibility. Focused offline fixtures verify one admission contract-violation record and the existing bounded needsOperator escalation. After normal deployment observe a naturally capped non-closer head dispatching its final hammer; no worker live action or new smoke command is required. LEASEFAIR-03 verifies the per-base history records closer/daemon grants and releases, including the retry hold. LEASEFAIR-02 verifies the closer retry retains its lease across a synthetic CI wait after FIFO service; another daemon cannot overtake it. LAC-2097 recurrence focused fixtures cover authoritative unprotected branch metadata after 403, strict/unknown refusal, first-pass retention without a redundant CAS, diagnostic copied-source SHA-256, shared-path separated-hunk queues, and a fixed 120-second retry CI ceiling. Custody/cancellation owners and existing smoke promises are unchanged. After normal deployment observe fresh hashes, branch evidence, bounded holds, exact tested head/base re-entry, local-validation release reasons, ancestry-proved audit bases and terminal release without manufacturing traffic. Focused fixtures pin pending deferral for 300-second retry CI and conservative protected/checks-disabled 404 handling; pending gate charges are refunded under GATECAPBASE-01; certified-park evidence requirements remain unchanged. LAC-2097 clean smoke drains two queued validated PRs across unrelated base advances with unchanged source heads, no CI restarts, preserved author/HAM content and empty holder/waiters. Focused rendered-shell fixtures in test/hammer-self-rebase.test.mjs cover strict versus non-strict touching/disjoint advances, asynchronous acknowledgements, exhausted reacquisition without source mutation, fresh exact-head range evidence, one shared CI deadline including rebase time, and conflict/red/expiry release without live GitHub. Synthetic broker receipt recovery survives a lost acquire response without a delivery row or run record; live processes renew, failed releases retain the journal, and confirmed drain retries release with a positive acknowledgement. ITP-11 also verifies two synthetic ready OS holders carry one canonical gemini-reviewer identity; independent pools cannot acquire a third lease, cleanup/drain failures retain the durable fence until readiness succeeds, an in-flight release retains its local receipt during concurrent readiness, a terminal pre-spawn record without a PGID allows re-admission, and failed release immediately isolates its drained holder and starts authenticated recovery. No credentials, live broker, enrollment or live provider calls. The clean smoke also verifies SDK explicit false precedence, wire-only terminal meanings and rejected launch-success aliases. The clean smoke also projects wire-only success/failure and explicit false terminal events through the shared status parser. Targeted closer, merge-agent and hq-dispatch-status-json regressions cover stale active-worker recovery, final-cap reconciliation, uniform unverified success recording, wire-only bounded retry, cancel cleanup and normalized-event remediation settlement. The full parked/resumed vocabulary, capacity, retry descendants and secondary-probe persistence are covered offline by targeted launch-request-status and ama-closer-dispatch-priority tests; no live decision mutation is required. MERGESIGNAL-01 targeted ama-closer-dispatch-priority fixtures verify that advanced-head dispatch ignores obsolete reviewed-head completion signals, retains target hammer ownership without successful lease settlement, and probes/logs once. Existing sandbox smoke promises are unchanged. HAMATTEST-03 clean smoke selects shared exact-head review after the historical review ceiling and executes production coexistence through a bounded wait: live or uncertain hammer ownership queues no review and retains the wait owner, confirmed absence queues within the same poll and promotes the owner to review, and repeated observations reserve only one request. Non-permanent daemon failures yield. Only daemon reservations requeue; CLI processes return with fresh invocation IDs. Grants alone preserve failure evidence.
